references.text: Share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house! When you see a naked person, clothe them, and do not turn away from your own flesh and blood!
I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you looked after me. I was in prison, and you came to me.
If a brother or sister is without clothes and lacks daily food, and one of you says to them, 'Go in peace, keep warm and eat your fill,' but does not give them what the body needs, what good is that?

For I was hungry, and you gave me food; I was thirsty, and you gave me drink; I was a stranger, and you welcomed me; I was naked, and you clothed me; I was sick, and you visited me; I was in prison, and you came to me.
